kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أحرنشف (form IIIq)
# أَحْرَنْشِفُ (ʔaḥranšifu) /ʔaħ.ran.ʃi.fu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِحْرَنْشَفَ (iḥranšafa)
# أَحْرَنْشِفَ (ʔaḥranšifa) /ʔaħ.ran.ʃi.fa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِحْرَنْشَفَ (iḥranšafa)
# أَحْرَنْشِفْ (ʔaḥranšif) /ʔaħ.ran.ʃif/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِحْرَنْشَفَ (iḥranšafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
